lineage_note: Retain every provider error and reconcile its client token before another attempt. Keep the package, machine shape, image, and budget fixed across zone checks.
mechanism: Availability of the fixed g6e.2xlarge machine in the approved region.
source_outcome: three capacity failures created zero instances; the fourth zone launched one approved instance
summary: AWS rejected the fixed FERAL instance in three zones for insufficient capacity. A query after each error confirmed zero instances before a fourth zone supplied the single approved instance.
